# Ordinal

Ordinal is a collaborative social media planning platform for creating, reviewing, scheduling, and analyzing content across connected channels.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ordinal/.

## Actions

- **Add Idea To Calendar**: Convert an existing Ordinal idea into a regular calendar post on a chosen date.
- **Create Idea**: Create reusable Ordinal content for one or more supported social channels without adding it to the publishing calendar or publishing it…
- **Create Post**: Create an Ordinal calendar post with content for one or more social channels.
- **Get Post** (read-only): Return one Ordinal post by ID with its full channel content, attached assets, labels, profiles, status, and publish timing.
- **Get Profile Analytics** (read-only): Return follower history or post performance for one connected LinkedIn or X scheduling profile over a date range.
- **Get Workspace** (read-only): Return the workspace bound to the connected Ordinal API key, including its ID, name, slug, timezone, and creation time.
- **List Ideas** (read-only): List non-archived content ideas with filters and one cursor-controlled page of results.
- **List Labels** (read-only): Return workspace labels and their IDs for filtering or labeling posts and ideas.
- **List Posts** (read-only): List non-archived workspace posts with filters and one cursor-controlled page of results.
- **List Profiles** (read-only): List connected social profiles by capability so their IDs can be used for scheduling, analytics, or auto-engagement workflows.
- **Schedule Post**: Schedule or reschedule an Ordinal post for external publication to its configured social channels.
- **Unschedule Post**: Cancel a pending scheduled publication and change the Ordinal post status to Finalized.
- **Update Post**: Update selected fields or channel content on a non-archived Ordinal post.
